remaining_boundaries: This is Linux-user Core S/B2 subset self-compilation under RV64 QEMU, not SOS hosting or full language/R1a implementation.

The 64MiB proof counts allocated static compiler data/BSS and ELF span; it is not measured host RSS. Target stack is actually constrained to1MiB; max_frame is largest function frame, not exhaustive call-chain stack proof.
Behavioral tests and source mutation falsify the tested shortcut mechanisms; no finite test suite proves all programs correct.
I2 changes to main.vt require new generation artifacts/fixed point/statistics/metrics and targeted prefix regression. H/L/F/M acceptance remains valid if their hashes remain unchanged.
Independently copied author clean_build driver is rerun evidence, supplemented by distinct final CLI probes and backend mutation; it is not described as an independently reimplemented build system.
